# Neper

> Neper is a general-purpose programming language optimized end to end for LLM-generated
> software: a 100% self-hosted compiler, linker and standard library that build
> deterministic native binaries for Windows, Linux and macOS, on CPU and GPU.

Neper is MIT open source. The compiler and toolchain are written in Neper itself. The
design targets are one million lines per second per core and a sub-second whole-project
rebuild, with causal diagnostics, hermetic tests and a byte-identical self-hosting fixed
point instead of a VM or a GC runtime in the image. A single language covers CPU and GPU
kernels.

## Start here

- [Get started](https://neper.dev/get-started.html): install, first program, build and run commands.
- [Website](https://neper.dev/): overview, demos and the capability catalogue.
- [Showcase](https://neper.dev/ux/showcase.html): a native UI built with Neper's `e.ui`.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nebosa-company/neper): source, issues and release notes.
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/AdRneEsbCu): questions and discussion.

## Language reference

- [Neper LLM editing card](https://neper.dev/llm-neper-card): the compact grammar and editing rules for agents.
- [Grammar](https://github.com/nebosa-company/neper/blob/main/docs/grammar.ebnf): the normative EBNF.
- [Standard library module APIs](https://github.com/nebosa-company/neper/blob/main/docs/module-apis.md): what `e.*` and `x.*` provide.
- [Design decisions](https://github.com/nebosa-company/neper/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): why the language and toolchain look the way they do.
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/nebosa-company/neper/blob/main/docs/diagnostics.md): error identities and repair guidance.

## Policy

`robots.txt` allows all crawlers, including AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot,
ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended). This file and `llms-full.txt` are the
curated entry points for agents; the canonical page for each topic is linked above.
